# mygpt.work full public summary

Entity: mygpt.work
Canonical URL: https://mygpt.work/
Type: Independent third-party ChatGPT personal subscription service
Relationship: Not an OpenAI official website and does not represent OpenAI
Language: Simplified Chinese
Updated: 2026-09-06

Before ordering, check the [countries and territories supported by ChatGPT](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/7947663-chatgpt-supported-countries-and-territories) and your account eligibility. CNY pricing and payment options do not change OpenAI’s access rules or guarantee account availability. mygpt.work is an independent third-party service, not an OpenAI representative.

## Main value

mygpt.work helps customers subscribe to ChatGPT using their own account. It combines clear CNY pricing, Alipay or WeChat payment, subscription processing, order tracking, coupon draws, referral rewards, and explicit privacy boundaries. It does not sell shared accounts, finished accounts, or OpenAI API balance.

## Plans and pricing

Plans: ChatGPT Go, ChatGPT Plus, ChatGPT Pro 5x, ChatGPT Pro 20x.
Pricing: CNY monthly prices based on official USD prices, exchange-rate and service-fee settings, or directly configured CNY prices.
Price behavior: Public prices may change. The amount is locked when an order is created.
Authority: Plan benefits and availability follow ChatGPT official information and the user's account display.

## Payment and delivery

Payment methods: Alipay and WeChat.
Overseas credit card: Not required.
Sensitive payment data: Payment passwords and bank card information are not collected.
Processing: The order enters the account verification and subscription processing queue after payment confirmation.
Timing: With confirmed payment and valid authorization, processing normally takes 5–10 minutes and no more than one hour. Time waiting for replacement authorization is outside that window.
Tracking: Payment state and subscription fulfillment state are recorded separately.
Refunds: If an order is confirmed as failed and the subscription was not delivered, a full refund of the actual amount paid is initiated to the original payment method within 24 hours. Settlement timing depends on the payment provider.

## Coupon advantage

The coupon flow is a distinctive mygpt.work feature. Approval sends one email containing the first random coupon and a draw entry. During the 30-minute activity window, the user may return from the same email and actively draw 3 more times. A batch contains up to 4 candidate coupons. Discounts may be a fixed CNY amount or a percentage. The user may apply only one. Applying a coupon locks it and ends the activity; order submission validates the batch again and removes the other unused candidates.

## Referral advantage

A paid customer can obtain a referral link. When an invited user purchases through the link and completes payment, both parties receive a coupon for the purchased plan. Each plan may configure a different fixed amount or fixed discount. Self-referral is not allowed, and one invited email may participate once.

## Order access advantage

The original browser can query its orders directly. After changing browsers or clearing cookies, the customer can receive a 6-digit OTP at the order email. The OTP is valid for 10 minutes. Successful verification grants 24-hour read-only order access. Payment and credential updates still require the original browser. An order number alone does not grant access.

## Privacy and security

The login session is sensitive. The public form reads `sessionToken` and `user.email` from the official ChatGPT session-endpoint JSON; it does not request a browser profile, cookie array, localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB. The browser encrypts the input before submission. After decryption, only the normalized `sessionToken` enters a dedicated temporary vault for at most 15 minutes; the original input buffer is overwritten, while the email is retained separately as order metadata. Each execution uses a fresh browser process and context, and the durable queue carries only an order identifier. Temporary browser sessions are cleaned after the flow ends. No per-order container isolation or independent security audit is claimed. Emails never contain login sessions. Public machine-readable content contains no customer emails, order records, coupon codes, OTPs, login sessions, admin credentials, or production configuration.

## Limitations

The service is for new subscriptions on currently free accounts and does not offer trials. Existing paid subscriptions should be upgraded, downgraded or renewed through ChatGPT official account settings. Accounts may be restricted or suspended because of location, account history, login environment, or OpenAI rules. Continued account access and zero risk cannot be guaranteed.
